I implemented the CUE code-generator changes for optional collection parameters entirely in source files (no test files touched). All behaviors verified against the spec via a scratch harness that I then removed.

**`pkg/definition/defkit/expr.go`**
- Added `AbsentOrEmptyCondition` with `ParamName()` and `Branches()` (absent branch `Not(IsSet)` + set-and-empty branch `LenCondition(==,0)`).

**`pkg/definition/defkit/param.go`**
- `ArrayParam`/`MapParam` `IsEmpty()` and `LenEq(0)` now return `*AbsentOrEmptyCondition`; `IsNotEmpty()` stays a `LenCondition(>0)`.
- Added `ArrayParam.RequiredImports()` → `["list"]` when MinItems or MaxItems is set (once, even if both), else nil.
- Added `StringKeyMapParam` predicates: `HasKey` (→ `*MapHasKeyCondition`), `IsEmpty`/`LenEq(0)` (→ `*AbsentOrEmptyCondition`), `IsNotEmpty`, `LenEq`, `LenGt`.

**`pkg/definition/defkit/cuegen.go`**
- `conditionToCUE`: `LenCondition` and `ArrayContainsCondition` now emit bracket-access chained-guard syntax (`parameter["n"] != _|_ if …`); `MapHasKeyCondition` emits `parameter["n"] != _|_ && parameter["n"].key != _|_`.
- `AllConditions`/`And()` join with ` if ` when a chained-guard operand is present (no `(…) && (…)` wrapping), else ` && `; `Or()` always joins with ` || `.
- Added `isChainedGuardCondition` and `writeGuarded` helpers; `writeGuarded` expands `AbsentOrEmptyCondition` into two `if` blocks.
- Applied `writeGuarded` at the named render sites: validator `FailWhen`/`OnlyWhen` (refactored into `writeValidatorBody`), SetIf field-tree conditional groups, and SpreadIf spreads (unconditional spread now emits no `if` block).
- `OneOf` discriminator drops the `?` marker when both `Optional()` and a `Default` are set; keeps `?` when Optional without a default.
- Auto-import of `"list"` flows through the existing `RequiredImports` detection.
